mapper.insert: INSERT into account(account_id, user_id, account_name, account_type, owner_id, balance, account_currency, is_deleted) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{ownerId}, #{balance}, #{accountCurrency}, #{isDeleted})
INSERT into account_member(account_id, user_id, role, main_account_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{mainAccountId})
INSERT into account_member(account_id, user_id, role, main_account_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{mainAccountId})

INSERT INTO notification (user_id, title, content, noti_type, amount) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.title}, #{item.content}, #{item.notiType}, #{item.amount})
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, user_id, account_name, account_type, owner_id, balance, account_currency, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT am.user_id, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_type, a.owner_id, a.balance, a.account_currency, a.is_deleted, am.role, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM account a JOIN account_member am ON a.account_id = am.account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND am.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT am.user_id, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_type, a.owner_id, a.balance, a.account_currency, a.is_deleted, am.role, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM account a JOIN account_member am ON a.account_id = am.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC
